person_occlusion.method: footprint ∩ person mask on the mask's native grid (max-pooled, conservative); face mask = face bounding box, exact pixels

existing_text_collision.honesty: 0 regions with an IR-filtered list is a measured pass (no protected text); no protected-text source at all is NOT RUN

legibility.method: glyph pixels = overlay pixels close to style.color; background = rendered pixels around them (scrim included); WCAG ratio per 24px block, minimum block wins

displayed_text.method: Apple Vision OCR (accurate, zh-Hans+en-US, traditional->simplified folded) on the overlay-only layer at 50/70/85 % of the window; the best-matching frame must contain the whole IR text as a subsequence with no ellipsis
displayed_text.honesty: OCR can misread glyphs; a FAIL here is a measured discrepancy, not proof of a rendering bug — inspect ocr_text/frames_tried. Elements with no text are NOT RUN.

scrim.method: backdrop kind scrim*/band*: dark alpha region in the backdrop box (overlay luma 8–60; bright ink and its 5 px anti-alias/shadow halo excluded) ∩ person mask must be 0 px. Scrim overlap uses the nearest 5 Hz mask sample with bilinear upscale and an luma>8 noise floor (H.264 ringing is excluded); element occlusion keeps the stricter temporal union.
scrim.honesty: 0 elements means the IR declares no scrim/band backdrop; that is reported as NOT RUN, not as a pass

caption_typography.method: caption ink from the overlay-only pass below 55% H: luma > 60, element boxes excluded; line bands from the row projection; per-line ink height/width; bottom margin to the lowest ink row; face boxes from the perception contract
caption_typography.honesty: captions are measured only when the render actually contains them; no captions = NOT RUN, never a vacuous pass. Cue times come from --captions when supplied, else from the rendered ink.

non_text_graphics.method: ink-only pass minus glyphs/shadows = graphics (accent rule, hairlines, bars); rendered colour in the final frame vs the rendered local background (scrim/picture); WCAG 1.4.11 3.0
non_text_graphics.honesty: white hairlines at the exact ink colour are indistinguishable from glyphs and are covered by the text contrast check; this metric is advisory and never fails the build

timing.method: appearance = first frame whose in-box footprint exceeds max(0.5 % of the box, 3x pre-window noise); disappearance = last visible + 1

thresholds.displayed_text: IR text must be a subsequence of normalised overlay OCR; ellipsis = FAIL
thresholds.font_floor: IR fit.min_font_px is authoritative; legacy v1 floor is a hard check for style.font_size_px; otherwise a warning
thresholds.lower_third: face/hand overlap = 0; body overlap reported, not a failure
thresholds.text_onset: first ink pixel frame on the overlay-only pass must be within 1 frame of the window start

notes: every number is measured on decoded frames of the delivered MP4
face mask = face bounding box (conservative); person mask comes from the perception contract and is not re-validated by verify2
contrast is measured against the rendered local background (scrim included); contrast_vs_source is reported as an honesty check
determinism tolerance is explicit: mean |Δ| and max |Δ| on decoded frames
displayed text is OCR of the isolated overlay pass (mid-hold); OCR errors are possible and ocr_text is included for inspection
rendered footprint must keep 2.5 % of canvas width/height from the edges and two elements' footprints may overlap at most 0.5 % of the smaller box
scrim/band backdrops are checked separately: alpha region ∩ person must be 0 (lower_third: face/hands only) and text contrast is measured on rendered pixels
text_onset is strict (ink, not scrim): overlay-only pass required; a dark scrim does not satisfy it
caption_typography measures the rendered cue (line count, per-line ink height/width, bottom margin, caption/face intersection); no captions = NOT RUN
non_text_graphics is advisory (WCAG 1.4.11 3.0) and is excluded from the overall verdict
protected burned-in text comes from ir.perception.existing_text when present (design2 filters venue signage); otherwise from the mask document
